title: Passive directional sub-ambient daytime radiative cooling

E_BUILD.facts: Component materials, dimensions, three paint coats, assembly layers, shielding, base/frame and movable disk

E_TRACK.facts: Date/site solar geometry drives track shape; manual reflector motion; water-jet track from 1.5 mm aluminum

E_CAL.facts: Individual thermocouple offset correction; slope error propagated into uncertainty; copper-block bath against immersion RTD

E_OPT.facts: UV-Vis-NIR and FTIR integrating-sphere direct-hemispherical reflectance

E_ANGLE.facts: FTIR variable-angle reflection, s/p averaging; displayed incidence labels 12,30,40,50,60,70,80 degrees

E_ENV.locator: Note 4, p15; Note 7, p20; Figure 7, p8
E_ENV.facts: Protected DAQ, shielded ambient RTD, weather station; weather acquisition every 5 minutes

E_SOLAR.locator: Methods: Solar DNI and diffuse measurement
E_SOLAR.facts: Sun-normal DNI and GTI instruments on separate two-axis tracker; diffuse calculated as GTI minus DNI

E_STAG.facts: Simultaneous white/black devices, four-hour solar-noon window, aperture lids removed after first five minutes

E_POWER.locator: Experimental results; Figure 4 caption; Methods: Cooling power measurement
E_POWER.facts: Four-wire heater/PID temperature steps; 5 minute plateaus; last 2 minute averaging; heaters off before and after

E_FIXED.facts: 60 mm-wide fixed band plus two approximately 50 micrometre LDPE layers; paired stagnation measured on another day

E_MAP.facts: White emitter plus six extra thermocouples; three one-hour outdoor conditions; post-equilibrium averages compared with model

E_MODELS.facts: Diffuse-radiation calculation, COMSOL model, hypothetical optical comparison and application concepts are distinct from empirical observations

E_MAIN_MODEL.locator: Results: Directional approach; Figure 1; Figure 4 modeled comparison
E_MAIN_MODEL.facts: Radiative energy-balance framework and ideal/conditioned predictions

E_DATA.facts: Underlying data by author request; inspected supplement list contains SI and peer-review file

E_GEOM_AMBIG.facts: Schematic labels 10 cm vertical separation while text states reflector about 15 cm above emitter; exact datum unresolved

E_DAQ_MANUAL.facts: K thermocouples require configuration away from Type J default; 30 minute warm-up; actual channel terminal map

E_BATH_FILL.facts: Closed drain, retained plumbing, inspect residue and include immersed-object displacement before filling

E_TC_WIRE.facts: 36 AWG PFA insulated stripped-lead K-type probe; USB-TC p17 instead specifies 16-30 AWG terminal wires; transition is a reconstruction requirement

distinction.task_authored: Robot actions, interfaces, safety/QA gates and record contracts
